items.label: scanned signature
items.quote: Candidates are required to upload the scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10 to 20 KB). Image dimension of the signature should be about 6.0 cm (width) x 2.0 cm (height).

items.requirement: The candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a person of Indian origin from specified countries with a certificate of eligibility.
items.quote: A candidate must be either: (a) a citizen of India, or (b) a subject of Nepal, or (c) a subject of Bhutan, or (d) a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, East African countries of Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania(Formerly Tanganyika and Zanzibar),Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia and Vietnam with the intention of permanently settling in India.

items.requirement: The result of the required educational qualification must have been declared by the Board or University by the cut-off date of 2026-10-07.
items.quote: It is reiterated that the result of required educational qualification must have been declared by the Board/ University by the cut-off date i.e. 07.10.2026. Mere processing of the result by the Board/ University by the cut-off date does not fulfill the EQ requirement.

finalYear.detail: Candidates who can prove by documentary evidence that the result of the qualifying examination was declared on or before the cut-off date and they have been declared passed will be considered to meet the educational qualification.
finalYear.quote: The candidates who can prove, by documentary evidence, that the result of the qualifying examination was declared on or before the cut-off date and he has been declared passed, will also be considered to meet the educational qualification.

rules.quote: Age limit for the posts is 18-27 years i.e. Candidates born not before 02-08-1999 and not later than 01-08-2008 are eligible to apply.

relaxations.quote: 06 Ex-Servicemen (ESM) 03 years after deduction of the military service rendered from the actual age as on 01.08.2026
